riskAnalysis: R01 identified one HIGH blocking verification gap, GRR-0002.B01-R01-F01: the addendum-specific test did not prove every denial explicitly required by the approved scope-addendum packet. This strict-descendant remediation preserves the immutable R01 evidence and adverse ledger, adds an explicit approval-to-candidate ancestry guard, and adds disposable real-Git denial tests for stale/partial authority, copied fork authority, sibling/base candidates, self-review, substituted canonical references, extra scope, and explicit non-approval. Every new denial asserts that canonical backlog and control-state bytes remain unchanged. Credible residual risks are false acceptance of a forked or semantically substituted addendum and regression in the broader recovery lifecycle; the selected checks therefore include the complete 27-test recovery suite, full governed Python quality, all recovery and target-amendment authority validators, backlog and planning validators, deterministic views, review-site integrity, and Git hygiene. Ordinary amendment, task, Wave, and gate execution remains deferred and unauthorized.
